title: Vat specimen
concept: The creature floating in a specimen vat (breaks free when the spider smashes the vat).
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single preserved pale pink larva specimen on its own: a soft swollen segmented grub-like body curled into a C, translucent skin with dark veins, many thin jointed legs folded tightly against its underside, no face, no human features, wet glistening surface, front three-quarter view, not in a jar. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 1,500 triangles, 512 maps. Inside the vat's glass (the breakable organ).
sheet_v1: Studio product photograph of a single preserved pale pink fleshy creature specimen on its own, curled up like an unborn thing: soft translucent skin with dark veins, a swollen rounded body, several thin jointed legs folded tightly against it, eyes closed, wet glistening surface, front three-quarter view, not in a jar. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
